supersedes: all packages before v4.2, including v4.1

target_stack.theme: custom block theme or child theme with reusable components
target_stack.database: WordPress/WooCommerce tables plus versioned custom tables only where domain concurrency requires them
target_stack.queue: Action Scheduler or equivalent background queue

implementation_phases.name: Future media rental
build: independent rental plugin and operational workflows

stop_rules: Stop phase 1 if mobile OTP security tests fail.
Stop launch if crawl/indexability/redirect evidence is incomplete.
Stop commerce release if price validation or payment idempotency fails.
Do not begin media-rental implementation before the initial site is public and measured.
Do not reopen architecture for a nice-to-have request; place it in backlog.
definition_of_done_foundation: All migrations are versioned and reversible or safely forward-fixable.
Core routes and namespaces exist without exposing unfinished modules.
Product and ProductVariant are reusable across shop, services, projects and future rental.
Cart and Order adapters accept registered line types without schema replacement.
Feature flags can hide future rental UI and API surfaces.
Event bus can register payment, order and future reservation events.
Home reads approved content through components/data providers, not duplicate hardcoded copies.
Automated smoke tests and manual responsive checks pass.
Backup and rollback are demonstrated on staging.
Authorization policy registry supports public, authenticated, role-based and customer-restricted scopes without building the future rental UI.
Ticket, conversation, attachment and creative-approval interfaces are registered but no operational module is implemented in phase 1.
Future rental price/calendar visibility and private customer allocation can be added through policies and new tables without changing Product, Cart, Order, Home or public URLs.
No phase-1 deliverable expands into advanced CRM, multi-user organization accounts or a full rental engine.

architecture_freeze.rule: No new architecture capability enters the initial release unless it blocks launch, security, legal compliance, data integrity, indexability or core sales.
architecture_freeze.freeze_until: public launch plus first 30-day measurement cycle
